parameters.text:
=Analyze this customer data and predict churn risk for each customer.

Customers: {{ JSON.stringify($('Fetch All Active Customers').all().map(i=>i.json)) }}
Usage Data: {{ JSON.stringify($('Fetch Usage Data').all().map(i=>i.json)) }}

For each customer score churn risk based on:
- Login frequency (declining = bad)
- Feature usage (low = bad)
- Support tickets (high = bad)
- Contract age (newer = higher risk)
- Payment history (late = bad)
- Last activity date

Return JSON array:
[{
  "customer_id": "",
  "customer_name": "",
  "churn_score": 0,
  "risk_level": "high/medium/low",
  "top_signals": ["signal1", "signal2"],
  "recommended_action": "specific action to take",
  "urgency": "immediate/this_week/monitor"
}]

parameters.jsCode:
const scores = $input.item.json.all_scores;
return scores.map(s => ({ json: s }));

parameters.subject: =Weekly Churn Risk Report — {{ $now.toFormat('MMM dd') }}
parameters.html:
=

Medium Risk

    {{ $json.medium_risk.map(c=>`

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Churn Predictor
Runs every Monday.
Combines customer CRM data + product usage data.
GPT-4o scores each customer 0-100 for churn risk.
High risk = immediate Slack alert + action recommendation.
All results in weekly email report.
